name: GPU-based Cell Projection for Structured Data
aliases: Cell projection algorithm for large volumetric data sets
definition: A volume rendering method for interactive visualization of large structured (regular) volumetric data sets on GPUs. It exploits data regularity to avoid redundant projection and sorting computations, dedicating over 60% of processing time to the rendering pipeline, achieving speeds over 5.0 M Tet/s.
summary: GPU-based Cell Projection is an interactive volume rendering technique for structured grids that eliminates redundant sorting by exploiting data regularity to achieve constant-time traversal and high performance.
